say:1:1610631001:1.text: Niall, during the restoration exam, what were you responsible for?
say:1:1610631001:1.source_cn: 尼尔，昨天在修复画像的考试时，你负责什么？

say:3:1610631002:1.text: Pippa and I were infusing magic into the portrait! I swear, the headmaster's death had nothing to do with me!
say:3:1610631002:1.source_cn: 我和皮帕要一起给画像注入魔力，校长的死和我没关系！真的...

say:4:1610631003:1.text: Relax. Just tell me what you know. What spell did you use, and why did it cause your mana to vanish all at once?
say:4:1610631003:1.source_cn: 不要紧张，如实回答我的问题就好。你当时用了什么魔法，为...

say:6:1610631005:1.text: Listen to me, Niall. Even if you used an unapproved method during the exam, that's a lesser crime than... murder. Tell the truth. It's in your best interest.
say:6:1610631005:1.source_cn: 尼尔，即使你在考试中使用了违规手段，也不会比“谋杀”的...

say:7:1610631006:1.text: I-I signed a <style="highlight">magical pact</style> before the exam... To help boost my magical power.
say:7:1610631006:1.source_cn: 我……我在考试前签订了一个<style=highlig...

say:8:1610631007:1.source_cn: 魔法契约？具体内容是什么？

say:9:1610631008:1.text: It let my power <style="highlight">keep growing on its own</style>. And if I needed a big burst of power, I could <style="highlight">borrow</style> it directly from a source...

say:10:1610631009:1.text: It really worked! My power started increasing day by day, all by itself!
say:10:1610631009:1.source_cn: 契约签过以后，我的魔力真的在慢慢增长。非常神奇，我什么...

say:11:1610631010:1.text: That's strange... Unnatural, even. And the power you borrowed, does it need to be repaid?
say:11:1610631010:1.source_cn: 奇怪，这很不正常……你从契约中借用的魔力是否需要偿还？

say:12:1610631011:1.text: Yes. After a month, the pact draws out my power to reclaim what I borrowed. Plus a little extra.
say:12:1610631011:1.source_cn: 是的，需要偿还。在借用魔力一个月后，我会被契约抽取魔力...

say:13:1610631012:1.text: Like interest on a loan. I see.
say:13:1610631012:1.source_cn: 嗯……和银行贷款一样，也需要收取利息。

say:14:1610631013:1.text: Who did you sign this pact with?

say:15:1610631014:1.text: A man in lavish attire... looked rich. His name was... was... Ngh!
say:15:1610631014:1.source_cn: 是个穿着华丽服装，看上去很有钱的男士，他叫……叫……他...
